csv_project_name: DB for Naval Air Maintenance Center
csv_scope_of_work: Design Build services for Naval Air Maintenance Center for Excellence (NAMCE), Tension Fabric Structure (TFS) Hangar 122, Naval Air Station Oceana, Virginia Beach, Virginia. The immediate project site is approximately 2.3 to 3 acres, however, when including transit routes on the installation, the project area expands to approximately 40 acres. In addition to the hangar, the project includes 20 supporting modular units that will be used for administrative and maintenance shop operations.
